app.title: Stitchwork — Cross Stitch & Bead Pattern Designer
app.description: Design cross stitch and bead patterns: key, chart, totals, OXS and JSON files.

header.saveToFileTitle: Download the pattern as a file you can keep anywhere (.json or .oxs)
header.imageTitle: Convert a picture into a pattern
header.referenceTitle: Open a reference photo in a floating window (you can open several)
header.checkTitle: Check the chart for likely mistakes

exportMenu.pngSymbols: Chart image — symbols only, for printing (PNG)
exportMenu.oxs: OXS — Open Cross Stitch (Pattern Keeper, WinStitch, MacStitch…)

tools.eraser: Eraser (E) — erases crosses, beads, partial stitches, knots and backstitch
tools.picker: Pick a key entry from the chart (I, or hold Alt/⌥)
tools.select: Select (S) — drag a box; Shift adds
tools.magicWand: Magic wand (W) — same key, connected; Shift+click selects all of that key
tools.partial: Partial stitches (Q cycles quarter / three-quarter / petite)
tools.override: Override (O): when on, drawing replaces stitches already on the chart. Off = only empty squares are filled.

status.hint: Space = move · hold Alt/⌥ = pick · O = override · Esc ends a backstitch line · 1–9 pick key entries · K hides the panel

key.heading: Key
key.emptyHint: Add the threads, blends, beads, knots and backstitch you’ll use — with their strands, stitch type and symbol — then pick an entry and draw.
key.rowTitle: Click to draw with this · double-click to edit

totals.heading: Totals & shopping list
totals.toBuy: To buy · {threads, plural, one {# thread} other {# threads}}, ≈{skeins} skeins

classic.note: Half crosses count as half the thread of a full cross (quarters ¼, three-quarters ¾, petites ½); blend parts count toward each thread.

label.knotWraps: French knot, {wraps, plural, one {# wrap} other {# wraps}}

keyDialog.chooseFlossBead: Choose a floss and a bead.
keyDialog.chooseBlend: Choose two different threads for the blend.
keyDialog.duplicate: Same colour, strands and stitch as {entry} already in your key. You can still add it with its own symbol.
keyDialog.typeLocked: This entry is already on the chart — only cross stitch ↔ floss + bead can be swapped
keyDialog.layerLocked: Can’t move an entry that’s on the chart to a different layer
keyDialog.findBlend: Find a blend for a colour:

dialogs.deleteEntryBody: It’s used {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} on the chart. Deleting the entry removes those stitches too.
dialogs.resizeHint: Shrinking crops anything outside the new edges.
dialogs.name: Name
dialogs.keepKey: Start with the same key (threads, beads, symbols)
dialogs.newHint: Unsaved changes to the current pattern will be lost — save first if you want to keep it. A snapshot is kept in History.
dialogs.noPatterns: No saved patterns yet. Use Save to keep your work.
dialogs.saveToFileHint: Keep this file anywhere (computer, cloud drive, email) and open it again with “Load file”.
dialogs.jsonBody: Everything: your key (including unused entries), blends, floss + bead, backstitch, partial stitches, knots, symbols, custom colours, pattern info and reference photo windows with their marks. Best for saving progress.
dialogs.oxsBody: Opens in Pattern Keeper, WinStitch/MacStitch, FlossCross and others. Floss + bead is saved as one blend item (e.g. “00557 + 310”). Can also be loaded back here.
dialogs.imageTitle: Turn a picture into a pattern
dialogs.imageHint: Each colour becomes a key entry: full cross, {n, plural, one {# strand} other {# strands}}. You can edit entries afterwards and the chart follows.
dialogs.keepReference: Keep the photo open as a reference window (with the stitch grid)
dialogs.gotoHint: Column, row — in the chart’s numbering (e.g. 12, 40)
dialogs.badCell: That cell isn’t on the chart
dialogs.mirrorTargetFull: The other half already has stitches. They will be replaced.
dialogs.copyFallback: Downloads aren’t available here. Copy this text into a file ending in .{ext}.
dialogs.clearMarksBody: This removes everything you’ve marked on “{name}”.
dialogs.closeRefBody: Its marks will be deleted too.
dialogs.drop: Drop a .json or .oxs pattern, or a picture

references.pan: Move / zoom the photo (or right-drag; wheel zooms)
references.marker: Marker — paint over what you’ve done
references.grid: Overlay the pattern’s stitch grid on the photo (and follow your cursor on the chart)
references.done: Shade squares you’ve already stitched on the chart

options.sameColour: Same colour, other strands/stitch counts as a neighbour

isolated.finding: {count, plural, one {Single stitch} other {Group of # stitches}} with no same-coloured neighbour

unusedEntries.finding: {sym} is never used on the chart

rareEntries.finding: {sym} is used only {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}}

toasts.needKeyEmpty: Add something to your key first — click “+ Add to key”
toasts.needKey: Pick an entry in the key first
toasts.fillBackstitch: Fill doesn’t apply to backstitch or knots — use draw or line
toasts.overrideOn: Override on — drawing replaces existing stitches
toasts.overrideOff: Override off — only empty squares are filled
toasts.saveFailed: Could not save here — use Save to file instead
toasts.tooLarge: Pattern is too large to save in the library — use Save to file
toasts.loadedReport: Loaded {name} — {count} quarter stitches or ornaments simplified or skipped
toasts.badFile: Couldn’t read that file — it should be a Stitchwork .json or an .oxs
toasts.dropHint: Drop a .json or .oxs pattern, or a picture
toasts.refsTooBig: Reference photos are too big to remember in this browser — use Save to file (.json) to keep them
toasts.newTwins: {count, plural, one {# new key entry} other {# new key entries}} for mirrored half crosses
toasts.pasted: Pasted — click or press Enter to place
toasts.partialNeedsCross: Partial stitches use a cross-stitch entry — pick one in the key
